headline: Palantine Berm and Linn of Mercy Shake Under Renewed Assaults
war_summary: Since the last edition, combat in Palantine Berm has reignited with vigor, yielding four fresh base transitions across the past two hours alongside sustained skirmishing. Fighting remains equally volatile in the Linn of Mercy, where contested positions around Outwich Ranch and Lathair saw continued turnovers, even as overall casualty rates began to moderate from earlier peaks. Further south, Gutter witnessed a sharp flare-up over the past six hours that culminated in Colonial forces securing Suojus amid rapidly accelerating losses. Meanwhile, massive attritional slugfests persist in the Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf, where both factions exchanged thousands of casualties despite static boundary markers over recent hours. The Nevish Line registered a sharp uptick in hourly casualty rates, whereas Mooring County settled into a distinct lull following its earlier flurry of base captures. Rear sectors across the northern and southern expanses remain virtually quiet, keeping operational focus firmly locked on the central fighting corridors.
